messages:
Ava (People Ops): @channel Quick heads-up — we’re kicking off a 2-week SOC2 evidence sprint starting Monday 03/10. Goal: get all outstanding artifacts uploaded and tagged so auditors can start review the week after. Please read and follow the tagging rules below.

Ava (People Ops): Required actions: 1) Upload artifacts to the Evidence Drive (Confluence/Drive link in thread). 2) Use the naming convention: <team>_<control-id>_<artifact-short>_YYYYMMDD.pdf. 3) Add yourself to the evidence-owners CSV (link). Deadline: end of day 03/21.

Ava (People Ops): We’re also doing an ISO crosswalk at the same time — if you’ve already got ISO artifacts, re-tag them using the same convention and add the ISO mapping column in the CSV.

Jordan (Security): Quick note — for infra logs we need the raw export + a short README describing retention and access controls. If exporting from GCP, use: 
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=gce_instance' --project=redwood-ops --format=json > infra-logs-<date>.json
```
Add the README next to the JSON.

Riley (Eng): Ack. I’ll grab the request logs from the inference cluster and drop them in /evidence/eng by Tue EOD. Who’s the owner for control AC-4?

Ava (People Ops): Riley, AC-4 owner is Sam (Platform). If you and Sam want to pair up on the README that’d be great.

Sam (Platform): I can pair on AC-4 tomorrow at 10am. Also, small ask: please don’t upload zips named "final" — we need the atomic artifacts named per convention so auditors can map them. :folded_hands:

Riley (Eng): Got it. 10am works.

Jordan (Security): FYI: if you need a temporary exception for any artifact (e.g., sensitive customer data), open an evidence-exception ticket and tag it in the CSV. We’ll triage same-day.

Ava (People Ops): We’re running two drop-in office hours next week in #help: Wed 11am-12pm and Thu 4pm-5pm for upload help and naming checks. Bring your file names and I’ll spot-check.

Riley (Eng): Thanks — will bring sample filenames.

ComplianceBot: Reminder: 3 artifacts still missing for eng (AC-3, AC-7, SI-2). Please upload by 03/18 to avoid backlog.

Ava (People Ops): If you’re blocked by legal review or redaction, post here and tag @Jordan. We’ll escalate.

Sam (Platform): One last thing — we updated the evidence retention policy last week; uploads older than retention window will be auto-archived. If you re-use archived evidence, add a note with the archive path.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Action items recap: upload + name files correctly, update CSV with owners and ISO mapping, request exceptions if needed, join office hours for help. Ping me if anything unclear. :sparkles:
